# Faculty Profile — Externship Program

Mark Calloway joined Penn Carey Law in 2010 as an adjunct and was promoted to Executive Director of the Externship Program in 2018. Before Penn, Calloway served as a litigation partner at Morgan Lewis from 2002 to 2010.

His undergraduate degree is from Yale (1995); his J.D. is from Stanford (1998).

In 2024 Calloway received the Lindback Award for Distinguished Teaching for his work supervising the program's seminar component.
